visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a white t-shirt with orange stripes on the sleeves sits at a wooden table across from a woman with short black hair. In front of them is a white cutting board holding twelve small round orange snacks. The man uses a green stick to apply a green paste onto one of the snacks. (2) The woman picks up a snack and eats it. She immediately reacts with physical distress, placing her hand on her forehead and then her throat, opening her mouth wide as if in pain or discomfort. The man points at her and smiles broadly. (3) The scene shifts to the woman holding the green stick and applying more of the green paste to the snacks on the board. She looks directly at the camera while laughing. (4) Both characters reach for the snacks simultaneously after a countdown gesture. The woman picks one on the left and the man picks one on the right. They both place the snacks in their mouths at the same time. (5) The man chews and smiles comfortably. The woman initially looks neutral, then her expression shifts to one of intense discomfort. She gags, places her hand over her mouth, and leans forward in her chair, appearing to suffer from the spicy taste. (6) The woman continues to react dramatically, waving her hands and holding her neck while the man watches her with a celebratory and amused expression. The background is a brightly lit indoor living space with a dartboard visible on the wall.
